topic: External Light Control System Direction Light Status and Error Reporting
row_semantics: Each row represents a specific service interface for querying the status or error state of the direction lights within the Exterior Light Control System.

core_entities.name: ExteriorLightControlSystem
core_entities.description: The main system responsible for controlling external vehicle lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightSts
core_entities.description: Service interface to query the current flashing status of the direction lights.

core_entities.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_entities.description: Service interface to query the error status of the direction lights.

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightSts
core_outputs.description: Indicates the current flashing state of the direction lights.

core_outputs.name: DirectionLightErrSta
core_outputs.description: Indicates the error status of the direction lights.

core_faults.name: DirectionLightErrSts
core_faults.description: Reports whether there is an error in the direction light system.

engineering_interpretation: This table defines the service interfaces for querying the status and error conditions of the direction lights in the Exterior Light Control System. It specifies the parameter names, their possible values, and the expected behavior when these interfaces are called.
